column3: It has to be a lie
You know, this isn't a joke or anything...
*gulp*
The school trip is tomorrow.
You're lying! You must be lying, Manami!
I wish I was... but this is the truth.
Tomorrow... It's tomorrow...
You didn't... possibly forget right? It's a big event after all!
You must be joking.... Did you really forget about it?
H-How could I!
I-I wouldn't forget about it, of course!
O-Of course! Ah, I'm relieved.
I'm seriously screwed! I haven't prepared anything!
...It can't be. Tomorrow is the start of the school trip?
Ehh... Could it be that you really forgot?
How do I say this... Spot on.
Eh!? I was reeaally looking forward to this!
Manami, sorry! I'm going to get ready for tomorrow!
Look at this handbook carefully; don't make a mistake.
Okay!
It's easy to forget about your insurance copy or your phone charger!
Yeah!
Ah, and bananas aren't included in the snacks!
Bananas too! But this isn't the time to prepare bananas!
That's right. sorry, I'm also nervous...
Are you listening, Kyou-chan? There Are No Bananas In The--
Snacks! Right! Then I'll go buy some banan--
Geh, This isn't the time to do that! Calm down!
However, it's possible to forget to bring important stuff when packing in a hurry, so be careful.
It happens to everyone.
Like forgetting to bring your underwear during to the middle school trip...
Oh, so you were going commando that time.
Yes. That was tough!
And how did it turn out like that?! My brother! It was my brother!
What, so it was Rock, how silly.
Think you're better than him?
Geez. Anyway, call me if you don't understand something.
I'm looking forward to going with you, Kyou-chan, so I'll do my best to help out.
So don't forget anything! If you do end up forgetting, I'll--
lend it to me?
I won't.
Kyou-chan, is your head all right?
It's not good at all. I'm super stressed.
Geez, take it seriously.
Anyway, when we have problems, let's help each other.
Are you really all right? Do you need my help?
I'm all right! No, seriously!
Anyway, if you don't understand something, call me.
I'm looking forward to going with you, Kyou-chan, so I'll do my best to help out.
Kyou-chan! It's fine! Come back to this world!
Hm? Ah! Sorry! I blanked out for a moment.
I'm really worried about you.
